name: q1-relay-pics
description: pictures: the relay sheet (400 cells) with the final look; a touch at 8 s; signals view and colour by job

evals.js: const f = await moire.tissues.focus('relay', 1.5); moire.relayAt = f; const c = await moire.signals.now(); return JSON.stringify({f, n: c.n, junctionCells: c.junctionCells})
const f = moire.relayAt; moire.signals.drop(f.x - 17 * moire.cells.R, f.y, 0); return 'poked'
